baseline: Deployed 235e2021 main head on GPU2,4, groups8, uniform six-layer stages; candidate MTP_HEAD flag=-1.
cold_prefill: Each code/prose prompt has an uncached ~101k prefix; compare engine read time, also report client TTFT
decode: Matched fixed prompts, output hashes and token counts; engine full-decode and client first-to-last rates reported separately
validation: Same-binary ABBA, 3 repeats per code/prose, cold and warm, short append; fixed-seed/fallback correctness, two concurrent requests, cancellation recovery, logprobs compatibility; final internal logits, argmax, probabilities and token mapping bitwise parity; chained asynchronous events and buffer reuse.

deployment_conditions.output_parity: All corresponding requests exact; low-level full logits and shard merge parity pass
deployment_conditions.decode: At least 1% median benefit on both code and prose, with most matched cases improving; single pilot insufficient
deployment_conditions.prefill: No sustained regression: cold read medians no more than 2% slower per workload; inspect warm restore and append separately, rerun any material regression
deployment_conditions.runtime: No CUDA/nonfinite/API failures, intended routes actually used; all original prefill flags and layers unchanged

not_a_guarantee: Fixed synthetic workloads and actual Q5. No Q4 model switch. Need independent default-off old-binary comparison. Original prefill, main-head, slots and CPU policy stay fixed.
candidate: MTP draft-head rows split across GPU3,5, exact complete logits returned to GPU7 for unchanged probability tail; greedy solo PW2 only.
performance_evidence: Fixed performance requests must finish at length with completion_tokens=max_tokens. Require one matched full-request draft acceptance record with 0<=accepted<=proposed; report accepted/proposed and rate (null when proposed=0). Require equal finish reasons across corresponding arms.
freeze: Runner records and checks hashes of all five execution scripts, both evaluators and this plan before every arm; hash manifest is external to these files.
